title: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27815v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability. We propose a framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning, based on Riemannian gradient optimization, in which the optimization proceeds entirely within the quantum domain without requiring quantum measurements or classical feedback. We derive the Riemannian gradient update rules for a broad class of learning tasks and identify sufficient conditions under which the resulting training dynamics can be realized fully autonomously. Within this regime, we establish an exponential convergence guarantee, in the training iterations, for sufficiently small step sizes, and further analyze the training cost in terms of the growth of the circuit depth. translated_title: 基于黎曼梯度优化的自主量子机器学习
translated_abstract: 量子机器学习模型在训练过程中通常依赖于重复的量子测量和经典优化，这使得从量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的根本瓶颈。我们提出了一种基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，其中优化过程完全在量子域内进行，无需量子测量或经典反馈。我们推导了针对广泛类别学习任务的黎曼梯度更新规则，并确定了由此产生的训练动力学能够完全自主实现的充分条件。在此机制下，我们针对足够小的步长建立了训练迭代次数意义上的指数收敛保证，并进一步从电路深度增长的角度分析了训练成本。重要的是，我们进一步表明，训练后的模型……
tldr: 提出了一种基于黎曼梯度优化的完全自主自训练量子机器学习框架，无需量子测量或经典反馈即可在量子域内完成优化，并给出了指数收敛保证。
en_tdlr: A fully autonomous self-training quantum machine learning framework based on Riemannian gradient optimization is proposed, which performs optimization entirely within the quantum domain without quantum measurements or classical feedback, and provides an exponential convergence guarantee.
